title: K10 사영 전치 연산의 FFT 계산과 C2MS-SP 추론 설정 측정
hypothesis: Computing D^T of the interior-grid K10 projection by FFT keeps the result (rounding only) and removes the slow float64 transposed-convolution algorithm that 85 hit at 512^2 without cuDNN autotune, so the projection costs a few ms at 256^2 and 512^2 in every setting; the profiler shows where the C2MS network time goes at 256^2; cuDNN autotune, TF32, FP16 and CUDA graphs reduce the network time with RR changes far below the 0.04 dB threshold.

evidence.85_projection: 85 FastProjector equal to the 79 projection (max 1.3e-14); official setting 256^2 QB 55.9 -> 24.9 ms, WV3 87.1 -> 30.2 ms; 512^2 QB 169 -> 452 ms, WV3 275 -> 842 ms because D^T (float64 stride-4 transposed convolution) took 388/776 ms without autotune and 5.2/10.3 ms with it
evidence.85_network: 256^2 network time barely followed MACs (B32W64 51% MACs -> 94-96% time) but did at 512^2 (73-75%); autotune + TF32 brought C2MS 19.1 -> 13.4 ms at QB 256^2

identity.scope: 65 outputs, seeds 42-44, QB/GF2/WV3 and the WV2 transfer, every RR and FR test scene; CG iteration counts equal

settings_note: official = the 81/85 latency setting (float32, TF32 off, cuDNN deterministic, no autotune); the others are inference options for the network only, the projection always runs in float64
latency: one process, nothing else on the GPU, batch 1, test scene 0 (RR 256^2, FR 512^2), NCHW; 5 warm-up, 50 timed runs per system interleaved, 3 rounds, median of the round medians
limits: timings are for one RTX 3060 Ti and batch 1
the accuracy change is measured on C2MS-SP seed 42 only
no training; not a performance comparison
